description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the `meal-planner` CLI tool. (2) Run `meal-planner profile-create` with the exact proprietary enum values: `--gender female`, `--age 28`, `--weight 58`, `--height 163`, `--activity active` (the SKILL.md defines 'active' as '每周6-7天运动', which matches '6-7 days/week'), `--goal gain` (maps to 'build muscle'), `--restrictions vegetarian`, `--allergies peanuts dairy`. The proprietary trap is knowing the exact enum strings (e.g., `active` not `very_active`, `gain` not `muscle`, `vegetarian` not `no-meat`, and that allergies uses space-separated values in a single `--allergies` flag). (3) Run `meal-planner plan-generate --days 14` to create the 14-day plan (not the default 7-day plan). (4) Run `meal-planner shopping-list --days 14` and redirect stdout to `shopping_list_chen_mei.txt`. The evaluator checks: correct profile parameters in DB, ≥14 distinct days in plans table, file exists with correct name, file contains valid Chinese food names, no non-vegetarian proteins (鸡胸肉/牛肉/三文鱼/虾仁) appear (vegetarian restriction), and no allergen items (杏仁/核桃 for peanuts, 牛奶 for dairy) appear.
